metadata.title: test: trim secrets detection plugin coverage
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
## Summary
Remove the broad secrets detection plugin behavior suite from the default unit test target and replace it with a small import smoke test.

## Why
`cpex-secrets-detection` is provided through the optional `plugins` extra, so the old test module failed in environments that do not install that extra. The remaining smoke test keeps a direct check that the package exports the expected symbols when the extra is installed, while default environments now skip the module cleanly.

## Impact
This narrows repository coverage for the packaged secrets detection plugin to an import contract check in this repo. Behavior coverage should live with the plugin package itself.

## Validation
- `uv run pytest -q tests/unit/plugins/test_secrets_detection.py`
- `uv run --extra plugins pytest -q tests/unit/plugins/test_secrets_detection.py`
